DREAD.IRONCLAD.description: Ironclad's Dominion: at the start of each combat, all enemies gain 1 Demon Form.
DREAD.SILENT.description: Silent's Dominion: at the start of each combat, you lose 1 Strength and gain 1 Weak.
DREAD.DEFECT.description: Defect's Dominion: at the end of your turn, take 3 damage for each enemy.
DREAD.NECROBINDER.description: Necrobinder's Dominion: at the start of your turn, a random card in your hand costs 1 more this turn.
DREAD.REGENT.description: Regent's Dominion: whenever an enemy attacks you, you lose 1 Strength this turn.
